note: Descale rules DB. Every rule is evaluated against the running OS, arch and machine (vars, requires, running apps) — a rule that does not apply simply reports 'unavailable'. Safety tiers: 'safe' = pre-selected and regenerable content; 'review' = never pre-checked, the user must opt in. Cleaning moves files to ~/.Trash (action 'trash'); action 'delete' is permanent and used only where files are already trash; action 'command' runs an explicit shell command and is disabled until you set enabled=true.

rules.title: Application caches
rules.description: Third-party app caches under ~/Library/Caches. Regenerated on demand; apps may be slower on first relaunch. Apple's own caches (com.apple.*) and browser/dev caches are excluded — they have their own guarded rules.

rules.title: Browser caches (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox, Arc)
rules.description: Cached pages and images only — never cookies, passwords or history. Skipped entirely while any listed browser is running, because live profile databases must not be touched.

rules.title: Application logs
rules.description: Log files apps wrote under ~/Library/Logs (excluding crash reports, which have their own rule).

rules.title: Crash & diagnostic reports
rules.description: Old .ips/.crash/.panic reports in ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports. Nothing on your machine needs them after a bug is reported.

rules.title: Saved application state
rules.description: Window positions and restore snapshots in ~/Library/Saved Application State. Regenerated as you use apps; you may lose 'reopen last windows' once.

rules.title: Xcode — DerivedData
rules.description: Build intermediates and indexes. Fully regenerable, but the first build of each project afterwards is slow. Skipped while Xcode is open.

rules.title: Xcode — Simulator caches
rules.description: CoreSimulator caches (installed simulators and their data are not touched). Skipped while the Simulator app is open.

rules.title: Go — build cache
rules.description: Compiled package cache (~/Library/Caches/go-build). Regenerated from source on the next build; builds get slower once.

rules.title: pip — download cache
rules.description: Downloaded wheels/packages in ~/Library/Caches/pip. Re-downloaded on the next install.

rules.title: Homebrew — download cache
rules.description: Downloaded bottles and sources. Resolved per architecture: {brewPrefix} is /opt/homebrew on Apple Silicon and /usr/local on Intel Macs.

rules.title: npm — package cache
rules.description: The content-addressed package store (~/.npm/_cacache) and npm logs. Re-fetched on the next install.

rules.title: Rust — cargo registry cache
rules.description: Downloaded crate archives and extracted sources (~/.cargo/registry). Re-downloaded by the next build.

rules.title: Gradle — caches
rules.description: Dependency and build caches in ~/.gradle/caches. Re-downloaded/rebuilt on the next Gradle run.

rules.title: Maven — repository cache
rules.description: Downloaded artifacts in ~/.m2/repository. Re-downloaded on the next build.

rules.title: Empty the Trash
rules.description: Permanently deletes everything currently in ~/.Trash — including items you trashed yourself before this scan, and files other rules moved there earlier in the same session. For that reason it can only be run alone, is never pre-selected, and cannot be undone.

rules.title: Xcode — Archives
rules.description: App archives from 'Product → Archive'. Needed to upload a past build to App Store Connect or attach to a crash — delete only builds you will never ship or symbolicate again.

rules.title: Xcode — iOS DeviceSupport
rules.description: Symbol files pulled from each iOS device version you ever connected. Old versions can go; the next connect of that device re-creates them slowly.

rules.title: iPhone/iPad backups
rules.description: Full device backups in Application Support/MobileSync. These may contain the only copy of photos and messages — delete only backups you are certain you do not need.

rules.title: Old installers in Downloads
rules.description: .dmg/.pkg/.zip files in Downloads older than 30 days — typically installers already applied. Files newer than 30 days are never listed.

rules.title: Docker — prune unused images/containers
rules.description: Runs 'docker system prune -f' (dangling images, stopped containers, unused networks). Disabled by default: set "enabled": true on this rule after reading what the command removes. Requires the Docker daemon to be running.

rules.title: User temp files
rules.description: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp — leftover installers, log tails and crash scraps. Files locked by running programs simply fail to move and are reported, never forced.

rules.title: Crash dumps
rules.description: Application crash minidumps in %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps. Useful only while a bug is being debugged.

rules.title: Windows Error Reporting queue
rules.description: Queued and archived WER reports (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\WER). Already-submitted reports are safe to clear.

rules.title: DirectX shader cache
rules.description: Compiled shader cache (%LOCALAPPDATA%\D3DSCache). Rebuilt automatically; games may stutter for a few seconds on first launch afterwards.

rules.title: npm — package cache
rules.description: npm's content-addressed store (%LOCALAPPDATA%\npm-cache). Re-fetched on the next install.

rules.title: pip — download cache
rules.description: Downloaded wheels in %LOCALAPPDATA%\pip\Cache. Re-downloaded on the next install.

rules.title: Go — build cache
rules.description: Compiled package cache (%LOCALAPPDATA%\go-build). Regenerated from source on the next build.

rules.title: Gradle — caches
rules.description: Dependency and build caches in %USERPROFILE%\.gradle\caches. Re-downloaded on the next Gradle run.

rules.title: Maven — repository cache
rules.description: Downloaded artifacts in %USERPROFILE%\.m2\repository. Re-downloaded on the next build.

rules.title: Rust — cargo registry cache
rules.description: Downloaded crates and extracted sources (%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\registry). Re-downloaded by the next build.

rules.title: Explorer thumbnail cache
rules.description: thumbcache_*.db files Explorer builds for folder previews. They regenerate as you browse; files locked by Explorer are skipped automatically.

rules.title: Old installers in Downloads
rules.description: .exe/.msi/.zip files in Downloads older than 30 days — typically installers already applied. Newer files are never listed.

rules.title: Windows Update download cache
rules.description: %WINDIR%\SoftwareDistribution\Download — already-installed update packages. Needs an elevated Descale; stop the wuauserv service first if files are locked.

rules.title: Windows Prefetch
rules.description: %WINDIR%\Prefetch traces. Windows rebuilds them; clearing gives a short-term 'faster first boot' and slightly slower launches until rebuilt. Needs an elevated Descale.

rules.title: Delivery Optimization cache
rules.description: Runs the PowerShell cmdlet that clears Windows' peer-to-peer update distribution cache. Disabled by default — set "enabled": true after reviewing.

rules.title: Empty the Recycle Bin
rules.description: Runs Clear-RecycleBin -Force — permanent, cannot be undone, and (like on macOS) it must be run alone. Disabled by default.
